title: The Infinity Bonus: two strong wheels

lines.text: Ten levels is not the limit. Meet the Infinity Bonus: no depth limit at all.
lines.on_screen: The ten glass floors from explainer #6 glow, then the top opens upward to an infinity sign; title 'The Infinity Bonus'.

lines.text: Hi, I'm MTG, Your Digital Architect.
lines.on_screen: The JetUP logo disc, MTG crown | Your Digital Architect, the title. No photo.

lines.text: And Profit Share: one and a half percent of the strategy's profit on every open level, paid from the thirty percent share, never from client deposits.
lines.on_screen: Ten level bars at 1.5% each, label "Paid from the 30% share, never from client deposits".

lines.text: It's a leadership bonus on top of the Profit Share, from level one, all the way down.
lines.on_screen: A second lime layer settles on top of the bars and runs down past level 10 with no end: "Infinity: from level 1, unlimited depth".

lines.text: Think of a bicycle with gears. Your gear is your rate, set by your team's new volume each month: from one and a half percent at fifty thousand dollars, to seven and a half at forty million.
lines.on_screen: A polished bicycle; its gear cassette shows the rates: $50K 1.5%, $200K 3%, $500K 4%, $1M 5%, then $3M 5.5% up to $40M 7.5%. The chain shifts up a gear on each number.

lines.text: And the trip meter resets every month: only that month's new volume counts, paid once a month.
lines.on_screen: The handlebar trip meter counts a month of new volume, then resets to 0 on a calendar flip: "Only the month's new volume counts", "Paid once a month".

lines.text: Rule one, the fifty percent rule: your strongest line counts for at most half. A bike needs two strong wheels.
lines.on_screen: The two wheels are two lines; the bigger one is capped at half: "Your strongest line counts for at most 50%" (example: for $1M, at most $500K from one line).

lines.text: Rule two, the difference rule: if a partner in your line reaches their own rate, you earn the difference on their structure. Three percent minus their one and a half leaves you one and a half.
lines.on_screen: A second rider in your line on their own bicycle in a lower gear: 3% minus 1.5% = 1.5% on their structure; chip "All your other lines: your full rate".

lines.text: So that's Infinity: your gear on your whole team, two strong wheels, and the difference rule.
lines.on_screen: Three ticked cards: Your gear on your whole team (monthly), Two strong wheels (50% rule), The difference rule. Small chip: JetUP's figures, check your partner account.

lines.text: Simple, right? Now it's your turn.
lines.on_screen: Buttons 'See the partner plan' and 'Join JetUP', mtgtribe.com/jetup pill.

lines.text: If I invited you, go to MTG tribe dot com slash jet up, and tap any Join Jet Up button.
lines.on_screen: The Join JetUP button is tapped on its words.

lines.text: Invited by someone else? Use their link. This video is for every team, so feel free to share it.
lines.on_screen: The fixed signature ending, links off, Next: step-by-step, part 1.
